title: ID0418641-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/R8 170002523] CPMS backend
description:
Reported issue: This is to inform you that from CPMS backend, there was a lot of time Remote stop message has triggered to charger. However that charger doesn't stop the session. Could you please let us know why it doesn't stop after receiving the message.
Solution: AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests = True

additional_info.subject: ID0418641-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/R8 170002523] CPMS backend CRM:02684000095
additional_info.body:
Dear Nadeem, good afternoon. I'm doing well thanks for asking, I hope the same for you.
This information you provided was really valuable as I was searching for an error that didn't exist.
I accessed the charger remotely and checked the configurations, and found the following:
This parameter needs to be set to True, otherwise you cannot RemoteStopTransaction successfully.
From your backend, request this change and you should be able to use it properly.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
